note: Frames are control steps after reset. Evaluation episodes cannot be replayed exactly; these are fresh rollouts. 'outcome' = metrics.body_outcome (what the body does in the reference walk, t 82-142).

clips.why: New in fix-5 (18% of the evaluation, fix-4 2%): the character walks sideways with the book and stays up (root 0.66 m, both ankles ~0.55 m along the walk; reference 0.87 m). The step detector finds almost no lift-offs (feet in the air < 3 frames), so check whether these are real steps or shuffling / sliding feet. Which hand holds the book, and how far behind the green reference is it?

Most common fix-5 outcome (42%, fall at median frame 104): after the lift the pelvis drops (~82), the root moves ~0.4 m AGAINST the walk direction and the character falls. fix-1 fell the same way (91/96). Does it start a step (reference: left foot 85-92, right 96-107) and lose balance backwards, or sit down? What do the arms / the book do just before?
17%: the root goes 0.9 m along the walk but the feet only ~0.2 m, then a fall at ~126. Look for a lean / topple toward the reference instead of stepping under the body.
24% still do fix-4's squat in place without walking (pelvis ~0.73 m). Compare with clip 1: is the state at ~80 visibly different (stance, pelvis height, book position)?

The strict 10 cm track still breaks during the lift (lead @62 / off_path @66), but later than fix-4 (58-60): 88% are within 10 cm at frame 60 (fix-4 18%). Look at how the book rises ahead of / beside the green pivot-and-rotate and when the right hand lets go (~67).
Perturbed lift fell from 72% (fix-4) to 56%. Does the hand go to the displaced red book or to the green reference position?
